description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController component, verifying its behavior in various scenarios such as default display name resolution, capability toggles, command generation, operator connection options, and persistence of last connection settings.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController class, focusing on display name resolution, capabilities, commands, operator options, and persistence behaviors.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the default display name is correctly set when missing in UserDefaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Verifies that the current capabilities reflect the toggled settings in UserDefaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that location commands are included when location is enabled.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Ensures that dangerous system commands are excluded from the current commands.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that operator connect options only request the approval scope when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Verifies backward compatibility of operator approval scope requests.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Tests reading the last connection details stored in the keychain.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Verifies that invalid stored connection data results in a nil load.
